caption: Palermo, 2015. Exhibition by the children of Borgo Vecchio Factory. Ema Jons, Per Esempio and PUSH.
alt: A handwritten sign welcomes visitors to an exhibition of drawings by a small group of romantic creatures who laugh light and cry nails.

caption: New York, 2016. 30 Weeks Program for Designer/Founders.
alt: A crowd fills a city park in New York for an open-air music event: people dance on the paved circle, others watch from the low wall and the grass. In the foreground a woman sits on the slope with one arm raised.

caption: Palermo, 2018. The launch of MUV.
alt: A man cycles along a palm-lined path in Palermo, past a MUV poster that reads: Palermo cyclists love this square.

caption: Santo Stefano Quisquina, 2019. Human Flows, Urban Thinkers Campus. Farm Cultural Park and PUSH.
alt: An audience on stone blocks listens to three musicians on a circular stage among ruined walls, high above the Sicilian hills.

caption: Palermo, 2024. Urban Journey of Palermo, PRIN project OSMOSI.
alt: Students sit in a circle on tiled benches along the seafront in Palermo at sunset, with Monte Pellegrino behind them.

caption: Palermo, 2026. Museum of the Diffuse Cities of the World.
alt: At a community event in a Palermo bar decorated with Palestinian flags, a man holds up a large portrait of a young man titled Cittadino del mondo, while the people around him smile and listen.
